author: JeffyBobZork
body:
Hello, my name is JeffyBobZork.

When I was banned, my IGN was crazypickle5, I think.
My brother and I shared a Minecraft account. I used to play on Avicus all the time.
Until my brother downloaded a hacked client and decided to fly hack in order to just zip on by to the captures and win the game in like 30 seconds.
I know that this is probably a story hard to believe, but trust me, it happened. I was very upset with him and just waited until my ban was over. Or so I thought, that in like a month the ban would recede. It didn't, so I waited another month until I gave up because I thought that I could never play again on this server. I was very sad :( 
Luckily, I just tried to log on and I actually read the screen, and it told me to visit the forums. Here, I am writing this appeal requesting that Avicus, or whomever reads this, to recede my ban.

If for no other reason, or you don't believe me or something, here is my final persuading statement. It was almost a year ago, can you please forgive my brother :(

This was hardly my fault, and I know that most of these appeals probably seem like just a paragraph of whining, but seriously, I was considering buying a rank thing until my brother did this to me.

I really hope this is read and considered so I can play some more Nebula. Thank you for your time.

title: Appealing an Infraction

replies.author: MidnightBeats
replies.body:
Hello.

Considering you have waited a year, I will appeal this infraction. I believe you have spent enough time waiting. However, if you hack again, understand that you will have no chance of being appealed.

Likewise, welcome back to the server!

Regards,
Midnite.
